title: paeonia officinalis subvar. banatica
intro: Paeonia officinalis subvar. banatica, commonly known as the Banatic peony, is a variety of the Paeonia officinalis plant, a species of flowering plant in the peony family. It is primarily used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Banatic peony include reducing pain and inflammation, relieving anxiety and insomnia, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia officinalis subvar. banatica include paeonol, paeoniflorin, and benzenoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional herbal remedies.
